description:
What is This Part?
This is the Combination Switch for the LHD (Left Hand Drive – American Model)
NOTE: Fits American LHD Models Only
NOTE: There are two different types of Main Plug for the SJ410. You MUST Verify that the type of plug on the this Combination Switch is the Type you need.
This is a NON-RETURNABLE Part.
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Combination Switch (LHD)
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1980 – 1984 All Models (Left Hand Drive Models)
